Method of Attack: JSP web shell allowing remote command execution
web shell used as backup for remote access
installation of web shells and file upload tools for persistence
Impacted Systems: Confluence Server and Data Center 7.4.0 and higher
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Atlassian Confluence zero-day vulnerability CVE-2022-26134
Indicators of Compromise: List of IP addresses released by Volexity
Yara rules released by Volexity to detect web shell activity
Dumped user tables of Confluence server
